item.description: A Nigerian Air Force (NAF) CH-4 unmanned aerial vehicle has reportedly crashed near Kontagora in Niger State, raising concerns over aerial surveillance operations in the region. item.title: Unregistered contractors face clampdown as Nigeria sets ₦5m penalty for firms
item.description: Companies and statutory bodies that award contracts to unregistered persons will pay an administrative penalty of N5 million under the Nigeria Tax Administration Act (NTAA).
